issues.description: Point labels A, B, C, D, P, M are smaller in the render than in the original, and their glyph style is lighter (original labels are larger, heavier italic serif). Positions relative to their vertices match.
issues.suggestion: Increase the label font size (e.g. \large or \Large in the node options) and use a heavier italic serif math font to match the original label weight. Keep the current anchor offsets.
